name: Citizen
_name_note: PLACEHOLDER until the owner names the archetype; the app and repo take that name.

citizen.name: the citizen
citizen.line: Someone who can found a community that lasts, and be a good member of one.

traits.name: Sovereign
traits.grant: You can leave with your name, your connections and your work.

traits.name: Civil
traits.grant: You can disagree with a stranger without making an enemy.

traits.name: Mobile
traits.grant: You choose your communities on purpose, and let others choose theirs.

traits.name: Enduring
traits.grant: You know why communities die, and what the lasting ones share.
